mainEntity.name: When should a pest control business consider investing in AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: A pest control business should consider investing in AEO when they aim to increase their online authority, capture more organic traffic from informational queries, and improve visibility in answer engine results and voice search. It's particularly beneficial if your current digital marketing efforts aren't generating enough qualified leads from users asking direct questions online. Investing in AEO is a strategic move for businesses looking to stay competitive in a search landscape increasingly dominated by direct answers and AI-driven results.
